checks: 19 exact native tests twice debug/release; repeated syntax; three compiled source mutants
cost: Argument helper scans O(A) per option and BTree weights O(W log W); command costs include loading, parser, repeated lattice/report work and output bytes. Selected tests exercise helpers only, no live file/model effects.
description: Argument helpers and effectful command dispatch for yomhadin.
forward: Parse first command and rest; positional skips value after every nonboolean -- option. opts parses weights strictly but defaults malformed max/depth/given. Commands load jurisdiction state, invoke helpers and print; judge parses case, formats report then optionally creates/writes protocol; extract can persist each jurisdiction before later errors.
inverse: Pure flag/positional/opts helpers cannot load corpus or write protocols. A malformed weight pair cannot yield successful Opts. For full commands, earlier side effects before later errors are not excluded.

An Opts output admits omitted options and malformed numeric strings that default identically; first option wins while duplicate weight keys keep last. Positional projection cannot recover consumed flags/values.

Only --flagged and --no-protocol are boolean; every other -- token consumes next token in positional even unknown or another option. flag independently sees first occurrence, so the two projections may disagree.
max/depth parse usize else defaults5/3; given parses u8 else None. Weights parse f64 and allow nonfinite values; report statistical interpretation requires separate finite-domain assumptions.

judge requires positional case, loads jurisdictions, parses opts, reads case, builds/prints report, then computes protocol and creates directory/writes file unless --no-protocol. Late I/O error can follow visible stdout.

do_extract iterates selected jurisdictions, gathers sources/trees, extracts then overwrites rules.tsv and prints count. Later jurisdiction error does not revert earlier writes; unknown source kind errors before current extraction.
limitations: Partial source-derived models and finite correspondence only
No live parser/corpus/frozen gold or protocol filesystem effects; no percentage surrogate
state: Finite synthetic rule/case states; valid indices, bounded paths, successful allocations. No legal authority claim.
